# Laura Mendes — Chief Financial Officer (SCP)

- **Relationship:** cross-org partner (no reporting line to Kate); the firm's **CFO**. Owns fund
  accounting, **capital calls & distributions**, valuations, and the audit.
- **Cadence:** monthly finance review; ad-hoc around closings and capital calls.
- **Owns:** the quarterly valuation marks in [portfolio.md](../context/portfolio.md); funds the
  capital call for any [Onyx](../projects/onyx.md) / [Halberd](../projects/halberd.md) close.
- **Distinguishing fact:** gatekeeper on fund-level compliance; her sign-off is needed before
  wiring equity at close.

## How to work with her
- Give her lead time before a close — capital calls to LPs need ~10 business days.
